observed_failure.phase: Publication runtime capability query: actual ffmpeg -hide_banner -muxers cleanup, before the publication observer.
observed_failure.exception: The Windows audio job exceeds its bounded membership inventory.
observed_failure.historical_cause: UNKNOWN; the old condition combined unequal counts and an over-cap count, without reporting either value.

production_changes: Capture the native class-3 query return length and fixed numeric diagnostic fields. Read native error state immediately and only when the API fails.
Requery only a successful partial result with 0 <= listed < assigned <=4096, before termination and inside the same existing five-second admission deadline.
Each requery re-enters the existing notifications/accounting path. No PID from an incomplete list is used as authority or shutdown proof.
Record the last observed query on a latched admission error without logging PIDs, filesystem paths, or process arguments.
preserved: 4096 process identity allowance and the original five-second cleanup deadline.
API failures, reversed/over-cap counts, invalid complete PID lists, membership failures and deadline exhaustion remain fatal.
Only a complete inventory can proceed to the original stable lifetime count, retained-handle validation, post-termination fence, exact lifetime coverage and per-handle exit waits.
No clearing of _admission_failure; no rebasing or new class-3 query after termination.
The original launch-before-resume ownership, kill-on-close, completion port, native leader/member close, and audio/process EOF observer code are unchanged.
All old test function bodies/assertions are preserved. Only two fixture hunks implement the newly requested native DWORD ReturnLength output; accounting queries still require a null output pointer.
The existing native process probe and its watchdog/assertions are unchanged.

scenarios: Partial list followed by complete list: no early PID adoption or termination; exact member wait/close preserved.
Permanently partial list exhausts the same five-second deadline and retains the exact latched error/handles on retry.
Six reversed or over-cap count pairs fail before opening any PID and never retry.
Three invalid complete PID lists remain denied after an earlier partial reply.
Coverage, lifetime fence and IsProcessInJob rejection remain authoritative after a complete retry.
Native errors 5 and 234 remain fatal; error capture precedes termination and records exact returned length.
Successful queries record ReturnLength without reading a stale LastError.

peer_review.scope: Exact production changes, native pointer fixture, and 17 additive modeled cases; source-only.

references.relevance: Defines the required and returned identifier counts and documents incomplete output; does not establish the cause of this historical failure.
Defines optional DWORD return length, nonzero success, and GetLastError only after failure.
Distinguishes lifetime process count from active accounting; existing proof requirements remain unchanged.

qualification: Source-reviewed candidate only. No claim that the observed failure was caused by a transient race; no native, release, installer, audio-quality or model qualification.
